description: NaMgBO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to two equivalent B and eight O atoms. Both Na-B bond lengths are 2.80 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.69 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing MgO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.10 Å) and two longer (2.14 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and three O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, two equivalent Mg, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Mg, and one B atom.
